court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
case_name: Padmakar Hiroo Jadhav And Ors vs Mrs. Kumud Subhash Jadahv And Ors

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Padmakar Hiroo Jadhav, Smt.Sumitra Surve, Smt.Meghna Vasant Shinde
parties.respondent_defendant: Mrs.Kumud Subhash Jadhav, Akhilesh Subhash Jadhav

facts_of_case: Original defendants/caveators challenging judgment and order dismissing caveat filed by them and decreeing suit. Suit was for letter of administration as prayed for by respondents.

legal_principles.principle: A Will is a solemn document by which a dead man entrusts to the living, the carrying out of his wishes.
legal_principles.held: It is an instrument by which a person makes a disposition of his property to take effect after his death.

legal_principles.principle: The court is required to see whether the testator signed the Will, after understanding the nature and effect of the disposition in the Will.
legal_principles.held: The court for examining proof of Will is also duty bound to see whether disposition under the Will is unnatural, improbable or unfair in the light of relevant circumstances.

legal_principles.principle: The duty is cast upon propounders of the Will to remove all legitimate doubts regarding suspicious circumstances.
legal_principles.held: At this juncture, it is necessary for the court to see whether the propounders have removed all suspicious circumstances making it worth to act upon.

outcome.final_order: Suit decreed, declaring Will dated 3rd December 1988 executed by deceased Hiroo @ Hiraji Laxman Jadhav as his last Will and Testament. Letter of administration ordered.

use_for_drafting: filing an appeal in a testamentary suit
